clone_chat_template: clone a chat template from a source tokenizer to a target model and tokenizer, resizing embeddings accordingly
add_response_schema: add a response schema to a tokenizer or processor based on its chat template for structured parsing
supports_tool_calling: test whether a tokenizer or processor chat template supports full tool-calling conversations
get_training_chat_template: get a training-compatible chat template with prefix-preservation and generation markers for a tokenizer
parse_response: parse a token sequence into structured response dictionaries with fallback to plain text decoding
